# Single-channel RxMER time series

56 captures of one modem/channel for Min-Avg-Max and Playback.

These are sanitized, user-provided lab captures. Open this ZIP or folder from
RxMER → Min-Avg-Max or Playback in the left navigation pane. The viewer groups
by binary header MAC/channel/frequency and sorts capture timestamps.

CM addresses use 00:ca:00:00:00:01 and, for multiple modems, sequential aliases.
Only MAC fields were changed; measurements and capture times are retained.
